identity.essence: Bridging corporate strategy, corporate affairs and stakeholder advisory through The One Thing — the single transformative action that cuts through complexity and creates clarity.
identity.positioning: For boards and executives navigating complex stakeholder environments, Duke Strategies is the strategic advisory firm that makes business strategies stakeholder-proof, by combining corporate strategy depth with communications craft, AI-driven stakeholder intelligence, and direct government and security expertise.

archetype.rationale: Strategic identity is Sage — knowledge, truth, analysis; the visual and surface realization is Ruler/luxury (see expression). meta.archetype=sage; website.archetype=ruler, website.aesthetic=luxury. The model preserves both: Sage governs who Duke Strategies is and how it thinks; Ruler/luxury governs how that identity is expressed visually.

Bold — challenger mindset; tells it like it is
Analytical — data and insights first, then judgment
Progressive — AI-forward, grounded in decades of experience
Decisive — The One Thing; cuts through complexity

company.name: Duke Strategies
company.description: Duke Strategies is a strategic communications and public affairs consultancy founded by former Hill+Knowlton Strategies executives. The firm combines deep strategic advisory expertise with AI-driven stakeholder intelligence to help organizations navigate complex political, corporate, and societal challenges across Europe and beyond.

services.name: Strategic Advisory
services.description: High-level strategic counsel for boards, executives, and leadership teams navigating complex corporate, political, and societal challenges. We develop stakeholder-proof strategies that align business objectives with external expectations.

services.name: Crisis Communications
services.description: Rapid-response crisis management and communications support. From preparation and simulation to real-time crisis management, we help organizations protect their reputation and maintain stakeholder confidence during high-pressure situations.

services.name: Stakeholder Mapping & Engagement
services.description: AI-driven stakeholder identification, mapping, and engagement strategy. We use proprietary analytics to map influence networks, assess sentiment, and design targeted engagement programs that build coalitions and neutralize opposition.

services.name: M&A Communications
services.description: Strategic communications counsel for mergers, acquisitions, and corporate transactions. We manage the narrative across all stakeholder groups — from regulatory bodies and media to employees and shareholders — ensuring smooth transactions and protected valuations.

services.name: Media Training & Positioning
services.description: Executive media training and public positioning programs. We prepare leaders for high-stakes media interactions, public appearances, and thought leadership campaigns through intensive coaching, message development, and simulation exercises.

services.name: Change Management Communications
services.description: Internal and external communications strategy for organizational transformation. We design and execute communication programs that build understanding, reduce resistance, and accelerate adoption during major change initiatives.

services.name: Issue Management
services.description: Proactive identification, monitoring, and management of emerging issues that could impact organizational reputation or operations. We combine media intelligence, political monitoring, and stakeholder analysis to anticipate and shape the narrative before issues escalate.

principles: Structure first: ink carries the structural weight — #222222 for type, table headers and rails, #141414 as the near-black canvas for dark sections, covers and chart panels. Coral is the signature, not the structure.

One large fill, deliberately: the coral block is a section canvas that carries the key message in white type (board 01 — the live site's own rhythm). Everywhere else coral stays on lines and the motif: rules, the cable-span fan, chart highlights (board 02 — lines and motif only). Never a photo wash, a gradient or a heading colour.

Bridges open and close, material closes in: every deck opens on a full-bleed Dutch bridge under an ink scrim and closes on one (steel vignette — contrast up); section dividers carry a bridge or a steel macro behind a large numeral; cable strands, rivets and plate sit behind content as flat, monotone backgrounds (steel flat — contrast down).
One family: Montserrat everywhere — 300 sentence-case display headings, 400 body, 500 caps labels tracked .18em. No second face, no uppercase headings.
Display-led scale: one very large headline per surface, everything else at body size — 'The One Thing' as typography.
Left rail: a permanent narrow rail (1/3) carries labels, dates, numerals and the mark; the wide column (2/3) carries the argument. Tables follow it — a caps label column, a grey header row.

Engineered restraint: the cable-span fan is the single identity mark — a small coral corner signature at a fixed size; as a surface pattern it stays under 12%. Icons are 1px hairline, square caps, no fill. Motion draws like a span being built (480ms) and settles.

Ruler/luxury surface kept, refined: airy spacing, deep soft shadows with 12px corners, outline ink buttons with coral only on hover, a 3px coral rule down every document page. The Sage strategic identity is unchanged.
signatureElements: Coral-square mark (logos/logo.svg) — the whole logo as favicon and app icon; white variant on photography and ink, coral/primary on paper
Cable-span fan motif — one pylon, six radiating cables — as a small coral corner signature (48×38px, fixed) and, faint, as the cable-fan surface pattern
Full-bleed Dutch bridge photography under a bottom-up ink scrim: steel vignette on covers and closings, steel flat behind content
The coral statement block: a full-bleed coral section with white type carrying the key message
Montserrat 300 sentence-case display headline — one per surface — over Montserrat 400 body and 500 caps labels
The left rail: labels, dates and numerals in a permanent 1/3 column; a 3px coral margin rule on document pages
Coral-on-ink charts: coral and white series on the near-black canvas
expression.signatureMotion: The bridge builds: cables draw from pylon to deck, then settle as content fades up.
antiPatterns: Coral as a photo wash, gradient, heading or body-text colour — the coral statement block is the one large fill; everywhere else coral is a line, the motif or a chart highlight
A second typeface — Space Mono, a serif, a display face, or Arial/Helvetica substitutes; Montserrat is the only family
Uppercase headings, or bold (600+) display headlines — headings are sentence case and light; weight is for small headings and UI only
Untreated colour photography in a layout — every image passes through a house look (steel vignette or steel flat) downstream; the library files stay clean
A flat 50% overlay or a coral multiply over photography — text safety is the ink scrim, bottom-up
Scaling, rotating, skewing or recolouring the cable-span mark; more than one mark per surface
The cable-fan pattern above 12% opacity, or behind running text
Placing the coral or grey logo on photography or ink — white only
Hedging language, passive voice, or jargon — voice discipline mirrors visual restraint

documentary-noir.label: Documentary Noir
documentary-noir.usage: Editorial black-and-white + fine grain — the neutral option when neither steel look fits (e.g. a print insert).

ink-duotone.label: Ink Duotone
ink-duotone.usage: Signature ink wash for a single statement image on a dark section — deep ink shadows through graphite mids to paper highlights. Use rarely.

steel-vignette.label: Steel Vignette
steel-vignette.usage: Cover and closing heroes — the bridges. Hard monochrome, contrast up, a dark vignette pulling the eye to the span. Every deck opens and closes on this.

steel-flat.label: Steel Flat
steel-flat.usage: Dividers, section imagery, backgrounds and textures — material macro and structural details. Monotone, contrast down, brightness down a touch so type sits on it without fighting.
